title: Ivo and the Terminal
author: Marguerite Thornbury
blurb: Coral Zhou, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
